thread:
Sam: quick design review note — in the autoscale SLO card the pool selector, min/max slider, and burst pill are visually reorganized in the new mock. on narrow widths the pool ends up after the burst which breaks expected left-to-right flow.
Ava: thanks — saw that in the PR. keyboard users expect slider -> pool -> burst. visual reorder should not change DOM order to avoid screen reader surprises.
Ravi: small product ask: can we also show a tiny estimated cost delta next to the burst toggle when enabled? engineers want immediate feedback during incident mode.
Noor: accessibility constraints: if cost delta appears transiently it needs aria-live="polite" and a readable label like "Estimated cost change: plus twelve cents per hour." Also ensure color contrast on the chip meets AA.
Jun: implementation idea: keep DOM order as slider, pool, burst. Use CSS to visually place pool left of slider on wide screens only. On wrap (width < 720px) let controls stack: slider full width, then pool + burst on the next compact row.
Sam: that layout sounds good. make sure tab order remains logical: min -> max -> pool -> burst -> save.
Ava: microcopy tweak: change helper under slider from "SLO target" to "Target latency SLO (ms)". also guardrail copy when max > 12: "High capacity 12+ GPUs14 consider Dedicated or contact Sales" with a link to docs.
Ravi: for the transient cost chip: show it only when a value changes and persist for 4s; include a keyboard-focusable info icon that opens a small tooltip describing calc assumptions.
Noor: tooltip must be reachable via keyboard and the info link needs aria-haspopup and aria-expanded states. add unit tests for SR announcement.
ux-bot: created branch ux/slo-pool-order-cost-hint-22733 and uploaded mockup slo_pool_cost_hint.png
Jun: i'll prototype CSS on the branch and test at breakpoints 320/480/720. attaching screenshots after.
Sam: scheduling a 15-min microtest tomorrow: 3 engineers, tasks: 1) set min/max, 2) enable burst and read the cost announcement, 3) change pool. note any focus jumps.
Ava: thanks team — Noor ping me when accessibility pass is done and i'll finalize copy in the product spec.
